typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_reportingPeriod VARCHAR(20) = ? DECLARE @File_Type Varchar(100) = ?  DECLARE @P_FileName VARCHAR(200) = (SELECT MAX([JSON_FileName]) FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE reportingPeriod = @P_reportingPeriod AND File_Type = @File_Type AND Rpt_Recipient = \'DHCS\')  DECLARE @P_Header VARCHAR(200)=(SELECT MAX(Header_Record)  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE [JSON_FileName] = @P_FileName)     SELECT CONCAT(@P_Header,(SELECT  planCode ,cin ,subnetwork ,providerGroupName ,providerGroupNpi ,providerGroupTaxId ,siteNpi ,providerNpi ,assignmentLevel FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_PCPA_EXTRACT WHERE  ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(CIN,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(subnetwork,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(providerGroupName,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(ProviderGroupNPI,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(providerGroupTaxId,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(siteNPI,\'\')!=\'\' AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')!=\'304\'  FOR JSON PATH ),\' }\') AS DHCS_PCPA_JSON',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceCADHCSPCPAJSONEXTRACT
SourceCADHCSPCPAJSONEXTRACT sink(input(
		DHCS_PCPA_JSON as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DHCS_PCPA_JSON)) ~> DHCSPCPAJSONFile
